title: Evaluation Inhaled Corticosteroids on Exhaled Nitric Oxide Gas Exchange
brief_summary: To evaluate the role of inhaled corticosteroids to suppress nitric oxide gas exchange in stable patients with moderate-to-severe COPD who are current non-smokers and not on oral corticosteroids.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of copd
* Current non-smoker
* Not on oral corticosteroids
* Must be able to use Advair discus or salmeterol discus

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Current smoker
* On corticosteroids
* Clinically unstable
